When I tried to return the fake bag, Nykaa fashion assigned a courier pickup partner called Shadowfax. On the day of pickup I see that the pickup was marked as unsuccessfull. The courier partner had whatsapped me checking availability and I had mentioned I was available. There was no call to my phone number or an attempt to pick up the item. I contacted Nykaa fashion customer support who assured me that a complaint was raised and they will pick it up in 24-48 hours. No one showed up in the next 2 days. This process of me calling Nykaa customer support and they raising an "internal complaint" did not work. They did not have a process to change the courier partner as well.
